messages:
Hannah: Doing a small docs tidy and found an orphaned asset and a stale gist shortlink in /kb/runtime/observability-latency.md. Scanner shows a 403 for an old CDN image and the gist returns 404 intermittently. No CODEOWNERS matched. Can someone take this?

Vik: Can you paste the snippet or file path? I can try to fix one or two today.

Hannah: Example lines:
```
![latency graph](https://old-cdn.redwood/diag/obs-latency.png)
See commands: https://gist.github.com/oldteam/5b2c1
```
Curl shows `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` for the image.

Andre: I can grab this. Plan: copy the PNG into /assets/docs/observability, replace the image with `/assets/docs/observability/obs-latency.png`, and move the gist content into `snippets/observability/latency-cmds.md` and include via our macro. I'll also add `alt` text and a tiny caption to satisfy the a11y linter.

docscan-bot: Auto-scan: orphan-image detected in /kb/runtime/observability-latency.md (confidence: high). No CODEOWNERS found.

Vik: Thanks Andre. Two quick asks: 1) use the include macro `{{< include-snippet "observability/latency-cmds" >}}` so tests pick it up, 2) add a one-line changelog entry under /docs/changelog for traceability.

Andre: Will do. ETA: PR by tonight. Note: if CI blocks new asset uploads, add `@infra` to the PR and ping infra-ops for a temporary allowlist.

infra-bot: Reminder: docs CI enforces asset bucket allowlist. If upload fails with 403, tag `@infra` in the PR for a one-off allowlist.

Hannah: Great — thanks @Andre and @Vik. If anyone else sees old-cdn references run `rg "old-cdn.redwood" docs/kb -n` and paste hits here; we can batch fixes.
